Volete chiedere ai Quarg la loro versione della storia, alla luce di ciò che avete appreso dagli Heliarch?

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	You're never quite sure who to speak with when it comes to the Quarg, but this time you're drawn to one that easily stands out. You judge it to be an older member of their species; its thin scales cover its fingers, and the more bony parts of its head have turned to a bright, silvery shade. Unlike most Quarg you've seen, it is wearing a pale, faded white robe, with patches of red-colored chains (that somehow perfectly transition into fabric again) becoming more and more prominent closer to the top, culminating in a firm, crimson hood covering its head. Most surprising of all for a Quarg, however, is the large scar taking up much of the left side of its face, completely covering where its left eye should be.|374|0
units.english: You're never quite sure who to speak with when it comes to the Quarg, but this time you're drawn to one that easily stands out. You judge it to be an older member of their species; its thin scales cover its fingers, and the more bony parts of its head have turned to a bright, silvery shade. Unlike most Quarg you've seen, it is wearing a pale, faded white robe, with patches of red-colored chains (that somehow perfectly transition into fabric again) becoming more and more prominent closer to the top, culminating in a firm, crimson hood covering its head. Most surprising of all for a Quarg, however, is the large scar taking up much of the left side of its face, completely covering where its left eye should be.
units.italian: Non sapete mai bene con chi parlare, quando si tratta dei Quarg, ma questa volta siete attirati da uno che si distingue facilmente. Lo giudicate un membro anziano della loro specie: le scaglie sottili gli coprono le dita, e le parti più ossute della testa sono diventate di una tonalità argentea brillante. A differenza di quasi tutti i Quarg che avete visto, indossa una veste bianca, di un pallido bianco sbiadito, con macchie di catene rosse (che in qualche modo tornano a essere tessuto con perfetta naturalezza) sempre più evidenti man mano che si sale, fino a culminare in un cappuccio cremisi e rigido che gli copre la testa. La cosa più sorprendente di tutte, per un Quarg, è però la grande cicatrice che occupa gran parte del lato sinistro del viso, coprendo del tutto il punto dove dovrebbe essere l'occhio sinistro.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It is completely static, with a lost gaze focused on the ceiling until you approach it. It doesn't squat down to meet your eye level. Instead it says nothing, simply gazing at you with its one eye, colored a bright gold.|375|0
units.english: It is completely static, with a lost gaze focused on the ceiling until you approach it. It doesn't squat down to meet your eye level. Instead it says nothing, simply gazing at you with its one eye, colored a bright gold.
units.italian: È del tutto immobile, con lo sguardo perduto fisso sul soffitto, finché non vi avvicinate. Non si accovaccia per mettersi alla vostra altezza. Non dice nulla: si limita a fissarvi con il suo unico occhio, di un oro brillante.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Hello, I'm <first> <last>. What can you tell me about the Coalition?"|377|0
units.english: "Hello, I'm <first> <last>. What can you tell me about the Coalition?"
units.italian: "Salve, sono <first> <last>. Che cosa mi puoi dire della Coalizione?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Hello. Is it true that the Heliarchs defeated you and stole your ringworlds?"|378|0
units.english: "Hello. Is it true that the Heliarchs defeated you and stole your ringworlds?"
units.italian: "Salve. È vero che gli Heliarch vi hanno sconfitti e vi hanno rubato i mondi ad anello?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It continues to stare at you for a while, without as much as blinking. It looks over to a bench in one of the quieter areas of the spaceport, and gestures for you to follow. As you two sit down, you notice it pauses mid-breath. After a few seconds of adjusting itself in the seat, the Quarg finally speaks up.|379|0
units.english: It continues to stare at you for a while, without as much as blinking. It looks over to a bench in one of the quieter areas of the spaceport, and gestures for you to follow. As you two sit down, you notice it pauses mid-breath. After a few seconds of adjusting itself in the seat, the Quarg finally speaks up.
units.italian: Continua a fissarvi per un po', senza nemmeno battere ciglio. Guarda verso una panca in una delle zone più tranquille dello spazioporto e vi fa cenno di seguirlo. Mentre vi sedete, notate che si ferma a metà respiro. Dopo qualche secondo passato a sistemarsi sul sedile, il Quarg finalmente parla.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Those three species arose in relative rapid succession, all in close proximity, compared to how other species tend to be separated by long periods of time, and longer still their distances." Its voice, while still sharing the buzzing, deep hums you've grown to expect from the Quarg, is broken up every other word by something like a crack - or a creak - as if certain vocal cords have grown sore, with an uncomfortable sound akin to an out-of-tune cello mixing its way into the Quarg's words. "So large are the gaps, that one might never learn of those that came before. But, that was not the case for the three. The first of them, the Saryds, were in many ways much like us Quarg in our younger days, and we perhaps were much too lenient because of that..." It stops, and brings one hand over its head, and then the other, closing its eye as if in a sudden headache. Your eyes almost instinctively go to its scales, expecting them to change like other Quarg you've seen. But, their colors remain unaltered, the same pale gray and silver shades. A few seconds pass, and it brings down its hands back to its lap, opening its eye as it continues. "The Kimek, traumatized by the billions fallen in their famines, sought help to make sure they would never face such a crisis again, and were eager to establish friendly relations with the Saryds. The Arachi, in a way, parallel humanity's development, though they were less keen on letting their inner conflicts be made public. They were the last of the three, and upon meeting their two seniors, invested heavily in research to catch up."|380|0
units.english: "Those three species arose in relative rapid succession, all in close proximity, compared to how other species tend to be separated by long periods of time, and longer still their distances." Its voice, while still sharing the buzzing, deep hums you've grown to expect from the Quarg, is broken up every other word by something like a crack - or a creak - as if certain vocal cords have grown sore, with an uncomfortable sound akin to an out-of-tune cello mixing its way into the Quarg's words. "So large are the gaps, that one might never learn of those that came before. But, that was not the case for the three. The first of them, the Saryds, were in many ways much like us Quarg in our younger days, and we perhaps were much too lenient because of that..." It stops, and brings one hand over its head, and then the other, closing its eye as if in a sudden headache. Your eyes almost instinctively go to its scales, expecting them to change like other Quarg you've seen. But, their colors remain unaltered, the same pale gray and silver shades. A few seconds pass, and it brings down its hands back to its lap, opening its eye as it continues. "The Kimek, traumatized by the billions fallen in their famines, sought help to make sure they would never face such a crisis again, and were eager to establish friendly relations with the Saryds. The Arachi, in a way, parallel humanity's development, though they were less keen on letting their inner conflicts be made public. They were the last of the three, and upon meeting their two seniors, invested heavily in research to catch up."
units.italian: "Quelle tre specie nacquero in rapida successione, tutte molto vicine fra loro, rispetto a come le altre specie tendono a essere separate da lunghi periodi di tempo, e ancora più lunghi dalle distanze." La sua voce, pur conservando il ronzio profondo e vibrante che avete imparato ad aspettarvi dai Quarg, è rotta ogni due parole da qualcosa come uno scricchiolio o un cigolio, come se certe corde vocali si fossero infiammate, con un suono sgradevole, simile a un violoncello scordato, che si insinua fra le sue parole. "Così grandi sono i vuoti, che si potrebbe non venire mai a sapere di quelli che sono venuti prima. Ma non fu così per le tre. La prima di loro, i Saryd, erano per molti versi molto simili a noi Quarg nei nostri anni giovani, e forse fummo troppo indulgenti proprio per questo..." Si ferma, si porta una mano sopra la testa, poi l'altra, e chiude l'occhio come per un improvviso mal di testa. I vostri occhi vanno quasi istintivamente alle sue scaglie, aspettandosi che cambino come quelle degli altri Quarg che avete visto. Ma i loro colori restano immutati, gli stessi grigi pallidi e argentei. Passano alcuni secondi, e riporta le mani in grembo, aprendo l'occhio mentre continua. "I Kimek, traumatizzati dai miliardi caduti nelle loro carestie, cercarono aiuto per assicurarsi di non dover mai più affrontare una crisi simile, ed erano ansiosi di stabilire relazioni amichevoli con i Saryd. Gli Arach, in un certo senso, seguono lo sviluppo dell'umanità, anche se erano meno propensi a rendere pubblici i loro conflitti interni. Furono gli ultimi dei tre, e incontrando le altre due, più anziane, investirono pesantemente nella ricerca per mettersi al passo."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It pauses again, taking a look around the spaceport. It fixates on you for a bit, then on the ships landing and departing here. "In the intersecting point of their territories, we built our ringworlds. Seven thousand Earth years ago, the three species of the Coalition sought to take over those rings. After centuries... no, a millennium of fighting, we left that part of the galaxy."|381|0
units.english: It pauses again, taking a look around the spaceport. It fixates on you for a bit, then on the ships landing and departing here. "In the intersecting point of their territories, we built our ringworlds. Seven thousand Earth years ago, the three species of the Coalition sought to take over those rings. After centuries... no, a millennium of fighting, we left that part of the galaxy."
units.italian: Si ferma di nuovo, dando un'occhiata intorno allo spazioporto. Si fissa su di voi per un po', poi sulle navi che atterrano e partono. "Nel punto in cui i loro territori si intersecano, abbiamo costruito i nostri mondi ad anello. Settemila anni terrestri fa, le tre specie della Coalizione cercarono di impadronirsi di quegli anelli. Dopo secoli... no, un millennio di combattimenti, abbiamo lasciato quella parte della galassia."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Why did they decide to start attacking you and your rings?"|383|0
units.english: "Why did they decide to start attacking you and your rings?"
units.italian: "Perché decisero di attaccare voi e i vostri anelli?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"|384|0
units.english: "Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"
units.italian: "Anche ora siete più avanzati di loro, no? Com'è che avete perso migliaia di anni fa, quando erano più deboli?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Whatever reasons they had, whatever drove them to attack us, we cannot quite comprehend... No." It stops, not sighing or showing much emotion, its scales still showing no sign of changing. It looks at the ceiling again, then back at you. "No. You are tired of hearing this same story from us Quarg, are you not? That the foolish and young species warred for no good reason." It pauses again, contemplating its words. "That war was not the first instance where we lost a ring of ours, but never did any of us wish for any ring to be lost in the first place. With three rings there, with the living space for over three trillion Quarg being constructed, we got awfully... protective of that region, in order to prevent outside interference from causing us trouble again. Our relations with the Kimek and Arachi were a far cry from the initial success and amicability we enjoyed with the Saryds, and when an Arach ship first showed signs of technology that repaired its hull platings mid-flight, an achievement even the Saryds were yet to make, we... jumped to conclusions."|386|0
units.english: "Whatever reasons they had, whatever drove them to attack us, we cannot quite comprehend... No." It stops, not sighing or showing much emotion, its scales still showing no sign of changing. It looks at the ceiling again, then back at you. "No. You are tired of hearing this same story from us Quarg, are you not? That the foolish and young species warred for no good reason." It pauses again, contemplating its words. "That war was not the first instance where we lost a ring of ours, but never did any of us wish for any ring to be lost in the first place. With three rings there, with the living space for over three trillion Quarg being constructed, we got awfully... protective of that region, in order to prevent outside interference from causing us trouble again. Our relations with the Kimek and Arachi were a far cry from the initial success and amicability we enjoyed with the Saryds, and when an Arach ship first showed signs of technology that repaired its hull platings mid-flight, an achievement even the Saryds were yet to make, we... jumped to conclusions."
units.italian: "Qualunque ragione avessero, qualunque cosa li abbia spinti ad attaccarci, non riusciamo del tutto a comprenderla... No." Si ferma, senza sospirare né mostrare molta emozione, e le sue scaglie non danno ancora segno di cambiare. Guarda di nuovo il soffitto, poi di nuovo voi. "No. Siete stanchi di sentire sempre la stessa storia da noi Quarg, vero? Che le specie stolte e giovani fecero guerra senza una buona ragione." Si ferma ancora, soppesando le parole. "Quella guerra non fu il primo caso in cui perdemmo un nostro anello, ma nessuno di noi aveva mai desiderato che un anello andasse perduto. Con tre anelli laggiù, con lo spazio vitale per oltre tre trilioni di Quarg in costruzione, diventammo terribilmente... protettivi verso quella regione, per evitare che interferenze esterne ci creassero di nuovo problemi. I nostri rapporti con i Kimek e gli Arach erano ben lontani dal successo iniziale e dall'amicizia che avevamo con i Saryd, e quando una nave Arach mostrò per la prima volta segni di una tecnologia che riparava le sue piastre dello scafo in volo, un risultato che nemmeno i Saryd avevano ancora ottenuto, noi... saltammo alle conclusioni."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"You 'jumped to conclusions'? What do you mean?"|388|0
units.english: "You 'jumped to conclusions'? What do you mean?"
units.italian: "Siete 'saltati alle conclusioni'? Che cosa vuoi dire?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"|389|0
units.english: "Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"
units.italian: "Anche ora siete più avanzati di loro, no? Com'è che avete perso migliaia di anni fa, quando erano più deboli?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"That's all. Thank you for speaking with me."|391|0
units.english: "That's all. Thank you for speaking with me."
units.italian: "È tutto. Grazie per aver parlato con me."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It slowly turns its head over to face you, with its eye gazing into your own. An uncomfortable minute passes at a snail's pace, as you seem to struggle keeping eye contact with the Quarg, while at the same time finding it difficult to look elsewhere.|393|0
units.english: It slowly turns its head over to face you, with its eye gazing into your own. An uncomfortable minute passes at a snail's pace, as you seem to struggle keeping eye contact with the Quarg, while at the same time finding it difficult to look elsewhere.
units.italian: Volge lentamente la testa verso di voi, con l'occhio che si fissa nel vostro. Passa un minuto scomodo, alla velocità di una lumaca, mentre sembrate lottare per sostenere lo sguardo del Quarg e al tempo stesso trovate difficile guardare altrove.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"We had gone there to protect the three species. To guide them. To observe them. We failed the latter, losing track of wisdom and reason in favor of fearing past shames. In that, our guidance became compromised, for they trusted us no longer. We were no longer seen as protectors, but as those they had to protect themselves against."|394|0
units.english: "We had gone there to protect the three species. To guide them. To observe them. We failed the latter, losing track of wisdom and reason in favor of fearing past shames. In that, our guidance became compromised, for they trusted us no longer. We were no longer seen as protectors, but as those they had to protect themselves against."
units.italian: "Eravamo andati lì per proteggere le tre specie. Per guidarle. Per osservarle. Abbiamo fallito nell'ultima cosa, perdendo di vista la saggezza e la ragione in favore del timore di passate vergogne. In questo la nostra guida si compromise, perché non si fidavano più di noi. Non fummo più visti come protettori, ma come coloro da cui dovevano proteggersi."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"|396|0
units.english: "Even now you're more advanced than them, aren't you? How come you lost thousands of years ago, when they were weaker?"
units.italian: "Anche ora siete più avanzati di loro, no? Com'è che avete perso migliaia di anni fa, quando erano più deboli?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"That's all. Thank you for speaking with me."|397|0
units.english: "That's all. Thank you for speaking with me."
units.italian: "È tutto. Grazie per aver parlato con me."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Are we so horribly powerful indeed, or is our might mere consequence of being elders in this galaxy littered with the premature deaths of other species?" it asks. "No... forgive me, I did not answer your question. We... many of our young ones and veterans alike vowed to never allow another ring to be lost. We do not kill for sport, but it has become as natural for a Quarg to defend a ring as it would be for a human to defend their family.|400|0
units.english: "Are we so horribly powerful indeed, or is our might mere consequence of being elders in this galaxy littered with the premature deaths of other species?" it asks. "No... forgive me, I did not answer your question. We... many of our young ones and veterans alike vowed to never allow another ring to be lost. We do not kill for sport, but it has become as natural for a Quarg to defend a ring as it would be for a human to defend their family.
units.italian: "Siamo davvero così terribilmente potenti, o la nostra forza è solo la conseguenza dell'essere anziani in una galassia disseminata delle morti premature di altre specie?" chiede. "No... perdonami, non ho risposto alla tua domanda. Noi... molti dei nostri giovani e dei nostri veterani giurarono di non permettere mai più che un anello andasse perduto. Non uccidiamo per diletto, ma per un Quarg difendere un anello è diventato naturale quanto per un umano difendere la propria famiglia.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"By the billions, defenders arose, ignoring our ways of peace, what social customs we were expected to follow, and... what you may call 'orders.' After a few centuries, those that tolerated, or were forced to tolerate the request for a ceasefire, were evacuated from the rings, and then it was only a matter of time before those of us that remained were overrun by the Coalition."|401|0
units.english: "By the billions, defenders arose, ignoring our ways of peace, what social customs we were expected to follow, and... what you may call 'orders.' After a few centuries, those that tolerated, or were forced to tolerate the request for a ceasefire, were evacuated from the rings, and then it was only a matter of time before those of us that remained were overrun by the Coalition."
units.italian: "A miliardi si levarono difensori, ignorando i nostri modi di pace, le usanze sociali che ci si aspettava seguissimo e... quelli che tu chiameresti 'ordini'. Dopo qualche secolo, quelli che tollerarono, o furono costretti a tollerare la richiesta di cessate il fuoco, furono evacuati dagli anelli, e poi fu solo questione di tempo prima che quelli di noi rimasti fossero travolti dalla Coalizione."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It once again starts looking at the ceiling, remaining like that for a minute or so.|402|0
units.english: It once again starts looking at the ceiling, remaining like that for a minute or so.
units.italian: Riprende a guardare il soffitto, restando così per un minuto circa.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|label|407|0
units.english: heliarch 2
units.italian: heliarch 2

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It then turns to face you once more. "We have of course noticed that headpiece the Heliarchs have provided you with. Though you have officially joined their ranks, you are human. You are not bound to that area of space. There is no need for you to obey their orders. You do not need to ever return there. There is no need for you and us Quarg to be enemies."|408|0
units.english: It then turns to face you once more. "We have of course noticed that headpiece the Heliarchs have provided you with. Though you have officially joined their ranks, you are human. You are not bound to that area of space. There is no need for you to obey their orders. You do not need to ever return there. There is no need for you and us Quarg to be enemies."
units.italian: Poi si volta di nuovo verso di te. "Abbiamo naturalmente notato quel copricapo che gli Heliarch ti hanno dato. Sebbene ti sia ufficialmente unito ai loro ranghi, sei umano. Non sei legato a quella zona di spazio. Non c'è bisogno che tu obbedisca ai loro ordini. Non hai bisogno di tornarci mai più. Non c'è bisogno che tu e noi Quarg siamo nemici."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|label|409|0
units.english: heliarch ask
units.italian: heliarch ask

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Is that a threat?"|414|0
units.english: "Is that a threat?"
units.italian: "È una minaccia?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"What if I do want to aid the Heliarchs?"|418|0
units.english: "What if I do want to aid the Heliarchs?"
units.italian: "E se invece volessi aiutare gli Heliarch?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"No. It is advice. Though you have joined them, you are still welcome at our rings, for the time being. But, the Heliarchs are a group formed and bound by their distrust and revulsion for our kind. Should you continue to follow the Heliarchs, sooner or later they are sure to put you against us, at which point I can no longer guarantee you will retain safe passage through our systems, or will be granted landing clearance on our worlds still."|425|0
units.english: "No. It is advice. Though you have joined them, you are still welcome at our rings, for the time being. But, the Heliarchs are a group formed and bound by their distrust and revulsion for our kind. Should you continue to follow the Heliarchs, sooner or later they are sure to put you against us, at which point I can no longer guarantee you will retain safe passage through our systems, or will be granted landing clearance on our worlds still."
units.italian: "No. È un consiglio. Sebbene ti sia unito a loro, sei ancora il benvenuto sui nostri anelli, per il momento. Ma gli Heliarch sono un gruppo formato e legato dalla loro diffidenza e dal loro disgusto per la nostra specie. Se continuerai a seguire gli Heliarch, presto o tardi ti metteranno di certo contro di noi, e a quel punto non posso più garantirti che conserverai un passaggio sicuro nei nostri sistemi, o che ti sarà ancora concesso il permesso di atterrare sui nostri mondi."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Your motives are your own, but if you were captivated by your own obsessions, then I can only hope you will come to see reason before you too are lost to their path."|430|0
units.english: "Your motives are your own, but if you were captivated by your own obsessions, then I can only hope you will come to see reason before you too are lost to their path."
units.italian: "Le tue ragioni sono tue, ma se ti sei lasciato catturare dalle tue stesse ossessioni, allora posso solo sperare che arriverai a vedere la ragione prima che anche tu vada perduto sulla loro strada."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It then turns to face you again, saying, "I am aware that you brought one from the Coalition to us, for a conversation. One belonging to a group that seeks to overthrow the Heliarchs. Do be careful, human, they might not be as technologically advanced as us Quarg, but they are very strong still, and duty-bound unlike most others. You and your allies are bound to face tremendous hardship, if you are to oppose them."|433|0
units.english: It then turns to face you again, saying, "I am aware that you brought one from the Coalition to us, for a conversation. One belonging to a group that seeks to overthrow the Heliarchs. Do be careful, human, they might not be as technologically advanced as us Quarg, but they are very strong still, and duty-bound unlike most others. You and your allies are bound to face tremendous hardship, if you are to oppose them."
units.italian: Poi si volta di nuovo verso di te e dice: "So che ci hai portato qualcuno dalla Coalizione, per una conversazione. Uno che appartiene a un gruppo che cerca di rovesciare gli Heliarch. Fa' attenzione, umano: potranno non essere tecnologicamente avanzati come noi Quarg, ma sono ancora molto forti, e legati al dovere come pochi altri. Tu e i tuoi alleati dovrete affrontare enormi difficoltà, se volete opporvi a loro."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|label|434|0
units.english: lunarium ask
units.italian: lunarium ask

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Will the Quarg help us fight the Heliarchs?"|439|0
units.english: "Will the Quarg help us fight the Heliarchs?"
units.italian: "I Quarg ci aiuteranno a combattere gli Heliarch?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Any tips on how to fight them?"|443|0
units.english: "Any tips on how to fight them?"
units.italian: "Qualche consiglio su come combatterli?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"We agreed to that conversation, that 'interview' of yours. Beyond that, we cannot help much without provoking war, I fear. We seek not to strike fear into the hearts of those of the Coalition, we never did. It would burden your cause to have us take part in the fighting."|450|0
units.english: "We agreed to that conversation, that 'interview' of yours. Beyond that, we cannot help much without provoking war, I fear. We seek not to strike fear into the hearts of those of the Coalition, we never did. It would burden your cause to have us take part in the fighting."
units.italian: "Abbiamo accettato quella conversazione, quella tua 'intervista'. Oltre a questo, temo che non possiamo aiutare molto senza provocare una guerra. Non cerchiamo di incutere timore nei cuori di quelli della Coalizione, non l'abbiamo mai fatto. Sarebbe un peso per la tua causa se prendessimo parte ai combattimenti."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Do not be arrogant. Do not underestimate them. Do not take victory for granted, no matter how cornered they may seem, lest you shall be cornered yourself."|455|0
units.english: "Do not be arrogant. Do not underestimate them. Do not take victory for granted, no matter how cornered they may seem, lest you shall be cornered yourself."
units.italian: "Non essere arrogante. Non sottovalutarli. Non dare la vittoria per scontata, per quanto possano sembrare alle strette, se non vuoi trovarti tu alle strette."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	You get up and are just about to leave when it says, "<first> <last>." The Quarg's gaze pierces you, its eye on the same level as your own. "Where is your home?"|463|0
units.english: You get up and are just about to leave when it says, "<first> <last>." The Quarg's gaze pierces you, its eye on the same level as your own. "Where is your home?"
units.italian: Vi alzate e state per andarvene quando dice: "<first> <last>." Lo sguardo del Quarg vi trapassa, il suo occhio all'altezza del vostro. "Dov'è la tua casa?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I come from New Boston, in the Dirt Belt."|465|0
units.english: "I come from New Boston, in the Dirt Belt."
units.italian: "Vengo da New Boston, nella Dirt Belt."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I come from Midgard, in the Deep."|468|0
units.english: "I come from Midgard, in the Deep."
units.italian: "Vengo da Midgard, nel Deep."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I come from Mainsail of the Paradise Worlds."|471|0
units.english: "I come from Mainsail of the Paradise Worlds."
units.italian: "Vengo da Mainsail, nei Paradise Worlds."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I come from Greenwater, in Hai space."|474|0
units.english: "I come from Greenwater, in Hai space."
units.italian: "Vengo da Greenwater, nello spazio Hai."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I was born on Earth."|477|0
units.english: "I was born on Earth."
units.italian: "Sono nato sulla Terra."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I come from <start planet>, in the <start system> system."|481|0
units.english: "I come from <start planet>, in the <start system> system."
units.italian: "Vengo da <start planet>, nel sistema di <start system>."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"My ship is my home."|484|0
units.english: "My ship is my home."
units.italian: "La mia nave è la mia casa."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I don't really have a home."|486|0
units.english: "I don't really have a home."
units.italian: "Non ho davvero una casa."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It acknowledges your answer with the faintest of nods. "Sparse were my own visits to the rocky worlds inhabited by other species. They are unlike our own. So different, so... complete." Its eye darts around, looking at your surroundings, other Quarg here, then finally its own hands and arms. "But us Quarg must make do."|488|0
units.english: It acknowledges your answer with the faintest of nods. "Sparse were my own visits to the rocky worlds inhabited by other species. They are unlike our own. So different, so... complete." Its eye darts around, looking at your surroundings, other Quarg here, then finally its own hands and arms. "But us Quarg must make do."
units.italian: Accoglie la tua risposta con il più impercettibile dei cenni. "Rare furono le mie visite ai mondi rocciosi abitati dalle altre specie. Sono diversi dai nostri. Così diversi, così... completi." Il suo occhio guizza intorno, guarda ciò che vi circonda, gli altri Quarg qui, e infine le proprie mani e braccia. "Ma noi Quarg dobbiamo arrangiarci."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	Though it is the faintest of movements, you swear the Quarg turns ever so slightly away from you. "It is perhaps only natural that a species ends up venerating their own homeworld, as the cradle that supported them until they could claim the stars." Then it leans in close and whispers, "But many still consider the birthplace of their kind as nothing more than a relic of a bygone age."|491|0
units.english: Though it is the faintest of movements, you swear the Quarg turns ever so slightly away from you. "It is perhaps only natural that a species ends up venerating their own homeworld, as the cradle that supported them until they could claim the stars." Then it leans in close and whispers, "But many still consider the birthplace of their kind as nothing more than a relic of a bygone age."
units.italian: Sebbene sia il più impercettibile dei movimenti, giurereste che il Quarg si scosti appena da te. "È forse naturale che una specie finisca per venerare il proprio mondo d'origine, come la culla che l'ha sostenuta finché non ha potuto reclamare le stelle." Poi si avvicina e sussurra: "Ma molti considerano ancora il luogo di nascita della propria specie nulla più che una reliquia di un'epoca passata."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	Your words seem to stir something within it, as it brings one hand over its scar, gaze dropping. "A harrowing sensation, is it not?"|494|0
units.english: Your words seem to stir something within it, as it brings one hand over its scar, gaze dropping. "A harrowing sensation, is it not?"
units.italian: Le tue parole sembrano smuovere qualcosa in lui, che si porta una mano sulla cicatrice, abbassando lo sguardo. "Una sensazione struggente, non è vero?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	After staring you down for a few seconds, it fixates upon the ceiling again. "I suppose others such as you may imagine that our own lives in our ringworlds are similar to your own within a ship or simple space station." It pauses again, for nearly a minute this time. "Considering the circumstances, that may be a reasonable conclusion on your part."|497|0
units.english: After staring you down for a few seconds, it fixates upon the ceiling again. "I suppose others such as you may imagine that our own lives in our ringworlds are similar to your own within a ship or simple space station." It pauses again, for nearly a minute this time. "Considering the circumstances, that may be a reasonable conclusion on your part."
units.italian: Dopo averti fissato per qualche secondo, si fissa di nuovo sul soffitto. "Suppongo che altri come te possano immaginare che la nostra vita nei mondi ad anello sia simile alla tua su una nave o in una semplice stazione spaziale." Si ferma di nuovo, questa volta per quasi un minuto. "Considerate le circostanze, potrebbe essere una conclusione ragionevole da parte tua."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	It faces you again, and asks, "Have you any more questions for me, Captain?"|499|0
units.english: It faces you again, and asks, "Have you any more questions for me, Captain?"
units.italian: Si volta di nuovo verso di te e chiede: "Hai altre domande per me, Capitano?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"Who are you?"|501|0
units.english: "Who are you?"
units.italian: "Chi sei?"

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|log|503|0
units.english: Full name Gohl Salyi Memt-Wrik Laz. It is an old, odd Quarg that is more open than its species tends to be in answering questions about rather sensitive topics.
units.italian: Nome completo: Gohl Salyi Memt-Wrik Laz. È un Quarg vecchio e strano, più aperto di quanto la sua specie tenda a essere nel rispondere a domande su argomenti piuttosto delicati.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	"I am called Gohl Salyi Memt-Wrik Laz. An old Quarg. Too old for my own good."|504|0
units.english: "I am called Gohl Salyi Memt-Wrik Laz. An old Quarg. Too old for my own good."
units.italian: "Mi chiamo Gohl Salyi Memt-Wrik Laz. Un Quarg vecchio. Troppo vecchio per il mio bene."

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	You thank it for its time, and see it get up to leave. As soon as it steps away from the bench, you notice a dozen heavily armored Quarg begin to follow it, some coming from the sides of the bench, others seemingly having materalized from the very walls and flooring. They follow Gohl in a machine-like formation, and never so much as acknowledge you.|505|0
units.english: You thank it for its time, and see it get up to leave. As soon as it steps away from the bench, you notice a dozen heavily armored Quarg begin to follow it, some coming from the sides of the bench, others seemingly having materalized from the very walls and flooring. They follow Gohl in a machine-like formation, and never so much as acknowledge you.
units.italian: Lo ringraziate del tempo, e lo vedete alzarsi per andarsene. Appena si allontana dalla panca, notate una dozzina di Quarg pesantemente corazzati che cominciano a seguirlo, alcuni spuntati dai lati della panca, altri sembrati materializzarsi dalle pareti e dal pavimento stessi. Seguono Gohl in una formazione da macchina, e non vi rivolgono mai il minimo cenno.

units.id: mission:Ask Quarg About Coalition Late|	When you last glance back at it before entering your ship again, you see the distinct reflection of Gohl's eye glancing at you from a distance, before being followed by the armor-clad Quarg deeper into the station.|506|0
units.english: When you last glance back at it before entering your ship again, you see the distinct reflection of Gohl's eye glancing at you from a distance, before being followed by the armor-clad Quarg deeper into the station.
units.italian: Quando vi voltate un'ultima volta verso di lui prima di rientrare nella nave, vedete il distinto riflesso dell'occhio di Gohl che vi guarda da lontano, prima che i Quarg corazzati lo seguano più a fondo nella stazione.
